description: An automated, self-healing Machine Learning pipeline for the Home Credit Default Risk dataset. Detects data drift using KS-tests and triggers automated retraining.

features.name: Health Check & Service Status
features.description: Returns API health status, model availability, and data artifact presence

endpoints.description: Retrieve API status, registered services, and model/data artifact availability

features.name: Statistical Drift Detection
features.description: Runs Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistical test comparing historical baseline vs production data to detect distribution shifts

endpoints.description: Execute KS-test drift analysis across monitored credit risk features

response_schema.400: Missing baseline or production data files

features.name: Automated Model Retraining
features.description: Triggers the ML training pipeline to retrain and serialize a new model version

features.name: Credit Risk Prediction
features.description: Predict default probability and risk assessment for a loan applicant

endpoints.description: Score an applicant and return default probability and risk classification

acceptance_criteria: GET / returns healthy status with correct service and artifact metadata
GET /drift/status correctly detects drift when production data has injected shifts
POST /train successfully trains and serializes a model
POST /predict returns valid risk scores when a trained model exists
All error cases return appropriate HTTP status codes
